method.volumeUnits: Household serving text read with the FDA labelling units (us-legal: tsp 5 mL, tbsp 15 mL, cup 240 mL, fl oz 30 mL); mL as written.
method.grams: serving_size when serving_size_unit is grams; otherwise a "(NNg)" in the household text. Rows with neither are dropped.
method.uncertaintyPct: Half a unit of the last printed digit of the gram weight, as a percent of the weight ("15.0" is read as a whole gram: 0.5/15; "1.2" as 0.05/1.2). Label grams are rounded by the manufacturer; this estimates only how coarse the printed number is.
method.median: Median of the per-row densities after dropping rows that repeat the same brand, description, household text and weight. All rows are kept in `rows`.
method.labelVolumes: Household measures on labels are rounded (to 1/4 or 1/3 cup, to a container size) and are nominal; rows for foods sold by container weight can be several percent low. `controls` runs the same method on foods SR Legacy already measures.
method.plausibleRange: Rows outside 0.05 to 3 g/mL are dropped as data errors.
